name: Envelope letter
oneLiner: a real kraft envelope on a leather desk opens its flap on twos, a folded letter slides out, the envelope drops away while the letter comes to the lens and unfolds, and the key words of a typed line get one brand-colour marker swipe
say: when the speaker shares a message, a lesson or a reply they got ('someone wrote to me', 'here is what I would tell you'): the letter comes out as they start and the underline lands on the words they lean on
